en: Customize your display, audio, and flight controls. Applied preferences are saved on this device.

en: Choose your display mode and frame pacing. Display changes include a recovery timer.

zh-Hans: 调整画质、飞行视野与泛光效果。
en: Tune image quality, flight field of view, and bloom.

zh-Hans: 拖动滑块可试听。点击应用以保存音量。
en: Volume changes preview immediately. Apply to save your mix.

en: Personalize the mouse virtual stick and flight bindings.

zh-Hans: 降低持续高亮的泛光效果。
en: Reduce bright bloom for a more comfortable view.

zh-Hans: 选择所有菜单、编辑器与靶场界面的语言。
en: Choose the language for menus, assembly, and the range HUD.

更改会先暂存。

应用：保存并使用。
撤销：恢复已应用的设置。

en:
Changes are staged until you apply.

Apply saves your preferences.
Revert restores the applied values.

Esc goes back.

en: Could not read preferences. Defaults were loaded.

列出显示器支持的分辨率与刷新率。
en: Available modes reported by your display.

en: Synchronize with the display to reduce tearing.

en: The Editor preview keeps its current window size. Display modes apply in a standalone build.

zh-Hans: 使用此项目提供的渲染预设。
en: Use a rendering preset provided by this project.

en: A wider view shows more space around your ship. Default: 65°.

zh-Hans: 让高亮灯光与推进器呈现柔和光晕。
en: A soft glow around bright lights and thruster trails.

en: Default: 0.65. Accessibility preferences can cap this further.

en: Player weapon pulses and nearby impacts.

zh-Hans: 切换到其他应用时关闭游戏声音。
en: Silence the game while another app is focused.

en: Mouse travel for the virtual stick. Default: 1.00×.

en: Reverse pitch input when moving the mouse vertically.

en: Mouse inversion and smoothing are in Controls. Audio offers separate music, effects, and interface levels.

zh-Hans: 应用后立即切换，保存的蓝图名称会保留原文。
en: Apply to switch immediately. Saved blueprint names keep their original text.

zh-Hans: 整个游戏均支持简体中文与英语。
en: English and Simplified Chinese are available throughout the game.
